request.title: Reset your password

request.unavailable: Password reset by email is not available on this instance. Please contact your administrator.

confirm.title: Choose a new password

confirm.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A few random words make a strong, memorable password.

confirm.newRecoveryConfirm: I've saved my new recovery code
confirm.totpHelp: This account has two-factor authentication. Enter the current code from your authenticator app to reset your password.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters long.
errors.wrongRecoveryCode: That recovery code doesn't match this account.
errors.resetFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.totpRequired: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
errors.invalidTotp: That two-factor code is invalid. Check it, or wait for a new one, and try again.
